ideas.pitch: A 2D puzzle platformer where the level geometry shifts in real time based on player movement patterns, built to excel under sudden theme constraints.
ideas.title: ChronoCanvas: Dynamic Procedural World Jam
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the rapid prototyping approach of past game jam winners by focusing on a hyper-polished core mechanic that judges can immediately play and understand.

ideas.pitch: A short-form visual novel set inside a fictionalized tech fest where dialogue choices dynamically alter campus dynamics and puzzle difficulty.
ideas.title: Echoes of IIITN: Interactive Narrative Mystery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the blueprint of educational and narrative-driven winners like AquaQuest by keeping scope tight while delivering strong artistic and atmospheric presentation.

ideas.pitch: A retro 8-bit arcade minigame wrapper that turns real-world task lists and hackathon progress into an RPG dungeon crawler.
ideas.title: Questify: Gamified Task Management for Hackathons
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs proven gamification mechanics seen in past retro-gaming and finance winners, making utility genuinely fun and engaging for judges.

ideas.pitch: An auxiliary plugin that lets players chat via voice directly with background game characters using local speech-to-text models.
ideas.title: VoiceRealm: Live NPC Conversational Mod
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the high-impact live integration strategy of award-winning AI assistant tools, guaranteeing a memorable live demonstration.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight tactical minigame featuring an autonomous AI bot companion trained to cooperate with the player against incoming waves.
ideas.title: Agentic Arena: Autonomous Sidekick
ideas.why_it_could_win: Pioneers lightweight agentic gameplay loops inspired by recent hackathon champions, scoring high on technical novelty within a game jam context.
